description: Remove the explicit exclusion for private-contract negotiation/style-only editing.
Broaden the description from forensic/institutional drafts to any legal text.
Remove language covering continuation/audit/translation of an existing formalization.
Allow activation even when all relevant documents are already present in context.
Remove the exclusion for greenfield implementation without an object of review.
Broaden blog work so meme-only edits count as blog authorship work.
Allow full voice recovery rewrites without a humor request.
Remove the requirement for a measurable feedback loop and allow one-off prompt polishing.
